ADC_ACTION_TYPE_GROUPS

Table to store ADC action type groups.

Columns
catg_id

PK, technical key

catg_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

catg_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, Fixed value ADC

catg_active

Flag to indicate whether rule group is in use

References

catg_pti_id, catg_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg)
